{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for missing values
missing_values = data.isnull().sum()

# Check for unique values in 'site'
unique_sites = data['site'].unique()

# Check for unique values in 'responded'
unique_responded = data['responded'].unique()

# Check data types
dtypes = data.dtypes

# Print summary
print("Missing values:\n", missing_values)
print("\nUnique sites:\n", unique_sites)
print("\nUnique responded values:\n", unique_responded)
print("\nData types:\n", dtypes)"}
